statement: Warren 2026-10-07: listing coverage for all eight reporting customers (Game, Makro, Computer Mania, Incredible Connection, HiFi Corp, Evetech, Takealot, Amazon). CIP proposes each retailer product page found by EAN or model on the retailer's own site for products that customer sells; a steward confirms; nothing auto-registers; one page reader per retailer; robots respected, per-retailer spacing, stop on 403/429. Listing capture polling is turned ON (about every 30 minutes for watched listings) once N-0073 is verified: the supervisor's worker environment sets CIP_LISTING_CAPTURE_SCHEDULE and CIP_LISTING_LIVE_FETCH. Daily search position per retailer site search uses terms Warren supplies.
